The '''Sontara system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the item known as the [[Sontaran song ball]].<ref name="CNIII">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Sontaran song ball]]|system=Sontara [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sontara [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
